title: Опасность Впереди: Часть 1
description:
This is the first entry of a three-part horror series that blends exploration, escape-room challenges, and stealth-based survival elements. This part includes three chapters.

You are John Rand, a search-and-rescue officer stationed in Richburg National Park. When young Elena Peterson disappears during a family hike, John and his team are dispatched to find her. During the search, John becomes separated from the others, forced to retrace his steps alone. 

 

Steam Achievements:

Chapters in Part 1:• Chapter 1: Connecting the dots.

• Chapter 2: Breath of fresh air.

• Chapter 3: Back to square one. 

Game Modes in Part 1:• Standard - classic game run.

• Torture - replay Chapter 3 with a more challenging puzzle (unlocked once Standard mode is completed).

• Speedrun - replay the game with a timer, no cut scenes (unlocked once Standard mode is completed).
description_short: Play as John, a search and rescue officer who must escape captivity from a secluded lodge. The game blends exploration with escape-room challenges and stealth-based survival.
